en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj who said,

‘Al-Tayyar said to him<sup>asws</sup>, and I was present, ‘This, which is increased, is it from the Masjid?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, they have not yet reached the remoteness of the Masjid of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup> and Ismail<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following:

“Al-Tayyar once said to him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when I also was present, ‘This thing which is added, is it of Masjid? He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is of Masjid, they still have not reached Masjid of Ibrahim and ‘Isma‘il, May Allah grant both of them favors.’”
